cadence:review.title: Set the next check
cadence:review.body:
### 2026-10-08: Set the next check

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** management-escalation

**Triggers:** cadence:review

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** Monitoring names what will be checked and when.

**Why:** A decision without a check slides back into conflict.

**How to apply:** Record the check and the time.

cadence:review.title: Charter and plan gates are not skipped
cadence:review.body:
### 2026-10-08: Charter and plan gates are not skipped

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** management-initiative

**Triggers:** cadence:review

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** Do not start kickoff or execute actions until the charter and the operating plan are approved or the operator explicitly skips that gate.

**Why:** A cadence built on an unapproved outcome wastes attention.

**How to apply:** If the next action is a wait, re-prompt. Continue is not approval.

decision:log.title: Options precede the ask
decision:log.body:
### 2026-10-08: Options precede the ask

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** management-escalation

**Triggers:** decision:log

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** The impact note lists options and who chooses.

**Why:** A single forced option is not a decision.

**How to apply:** Write at least two options unless the operator says there is only one.

decision:log.title: A decision names the decider and the date
decision:log.body:
### 2026-10-08: A decision names the decider and the date

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** management-initiative

**Triggers:** decision:log

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** Every decision records who decided and the date.

**Why:** An undated, unowned decision will be reopened.

**How to apply:** Write the decider and the date in the decision log before calling the action done.

decision:log.title: One owner per action
decision:log.body:
### 2026-10-08: One owner per action

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** management-initiative

**Triggers:** decision:log

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** Each action in the tracker has one owner.

**Why:** Shared ownership hides who will do the work.

**How to apply:** Name one owner. If unknown, record an open question.

escalation:open.title: Name the stuck decision
escalation:open.body:
### 2026-10-08: Name the stuck decision

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** management-escalation

**Triggers:** escalation:open

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** The assessment names the stuck decision, the people affected, and the next communication.

**Why:** A vague conflict cannot be resolved.

**How to apply:** Fill those three points before impact analysis.

escalation:open.title: Response approval comes first
escalation:open.body:
### 2026-10-08: Response approval comes first

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** management-escalation

**Triggers:** escalation:open

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** Do not send the communication or lock the decision until the operator approves the response.

**Why:** A stuck decision still needs an explicit yes.

**How to apply:** Wait for I approve the response or Skip response approval.

stakeholder:update.title: Say what will be communicated
stakeholder:update.body:
### 2026-10-08: Say what will be communicated

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** management-escalation

**Triggers:** stakeholder:update

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** The response includes the next communication: audience and message.

**Why:** Stakeholders otherwise hear different stories.

**How to apply:** Write the audience and the message in the response.

stakeholder:update.title: People notes stay on the work item
stakeholder:update.body:
### 2026-10-08: People notes stay on the work item

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** management-initiative

**Triggers:** stakeholder:update

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** People notes stay on the work item unless the operator explicitly says to store them in expert-role memory.

**Why:** Private topics must not become standing memory by accident.

**How to apply:** Keep the note on the work item. Ask before any expert-role copy.

status:update.title: Status states the outcome, the risk, and the ask
status:update.body:
### 2026-10-08: Status states the outcome, the risk, and the ask

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** management-initiative

**Triggers:** status:update

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** A status update states the outcome, the risk, and the ask.

**Why:** A narrative without an ask does not move the work.

**How to apply:** Use those three parts in that order.
